phase_1.description: <cite index="32-1,32-2,11-4,11-5">Mellow Fellow is a pharmacist-founded hemp cannabinoid brand operating within Arvida Labs, an industry-leading production and product development company. The brand produces a full range of alternative cannabinoids using proprietary formulations and one-of-a-kind blends, with all products pharmacist formulated and every batch of oil undergoing full panel testing to ensure safety and effectiveness.</cite>
phase_1.headquarters: South Florida (Hallandale Beach / Fort Lauderdale area), Florida
phase_1.business_model: <cite index="13-7,11-2,32-9">Mellow Fellow generates revenue through direct-to-consumer e-commerce sales via mellowfellow.fun, affiliate partnerships, and wholesale distribution to retail partners nationwide. The company produces pharmacist-formulated cannabinoid blends in mood-specific formulations (focus, relaxation, energy, recovery) and ships proprietary products across the United States where legally compliant.</cite>

size_estimate.employees: 2-10 (per LinkedIn); operates within larger Arvida Labs infrastructure
size_estimate.revenue_estimate: Not publicly disclosed; indicators suggest multi-million dollar operation based on national distribution, sophisticated manufacturing capabilities, and brand partnerships
size_estimate.evidence: <cite index="4-2,32-4,32-5,32-6">LinkedIn lists 2-10 employees and founded in 2021. The company became a top Delta 8 oil producer and expanded from founders to a family operation, with the pharmacist's sister running marketing and father and brothers joining from Mexico to build the growing business.</cite>

segments: Hemp-derived cannabinoids (Delta-8, Delta-9, Delta-10, THCp, THCv, HHC, CBD, CBG, CBN)

phase_1.brand_positioning: <cite index="13-1,13-2,13-3,13-4">Mellow Fellow is positioned as a pharmacist-founded company redefining modern cannabis with clarity and precision. <cite index="13-10,13-11">Burn Blend powered by THCv - won 2024 Bella Magazine Beauty Award, designed for focus, energy boost, and breaking creative blocks without fog</cite>
<cite index="13-17,13-18">Rest Blend with CBN in softgels, tinctures, and gummies for calming and unwinding without intoxication, popular among wellness-minded consumers</cite>
<cite index="6-1,6-2,6-3">Delta 9 THC + CBD Seltzer Beverages (20mg cans with 10mg Delta 9 THC and 10mg CBD for balanced relaxation)</cite>
<cite index="9-1,9-2,9-4">Live Resin Disposable Vapes crafted with live resin and custom cannabinoid blends using flash-frozen cannabis to preserve terpenes and full-spectrum effects</cite>
